Name: Operating checking
Notes: Earned fees, firm expenses and payroll funding

Name: IOLTA trust account
Notes: Client retainers and settlement funds. Its balance is never the firm's money

Name: Client trust account, interest bearing
Notes: Optional. A large or long-held sum for one client, with the interest belonging to that client

Name: Accounts receivable
Notes: Fees billed and earned but not yet paid

Name: Client costs advanced
Notes: Filing fees, expert fees and records charges paid for a client and billed back. Clears when the client repays

Name: Prepaid expenses
Notes: Malpractice premium or software paid annually, spread by month

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Firm bills, paid from operating only

Name: Client trust funds
Notes: Every dollar in the trust accounts, owed to clients. Must equal 1020 plus 1030 and the sum of all client ledgers

Name: Business credit card
Notes: Firm spending on the card, paid from operating

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll register

Name: Partner capital: Partner A
Notes: One capital and draw pair per partner. Rename to the partner

Name: Partner draws: Partner A
Notes: Money taken out by the partner during the year

Name: Retained earnings
Notes: Usually allocated to partner capital at year end

Name: Legal fees: Hourly
Notes: Recorded when earned and moved out of trust, or paid straight to operating

Name: Legal fees: Flat fee
Notes: Earned as the engagement letter says, not on receipt unless your state allows it

Name: Legal fees: Contingency
Notes: The firm's share once a settlement is disbursed from trust

Name: Interest income
Notes: Operating account interest only. IOLTA interest goes to the state program and is not firm income

Name: Contract lawyers and paralegals
Notes: Outside help on client matters, not billed back as a cost

Name: Client costs written off
Notes: Advanced costs the firm decides not to recover, moved out of 1200

Name: Staff salaries
Notes: Gross wages from the payroll register

Name: Malpractice insurance
Notes: Professional liability premiums

Name: Bar dues and CLE
Notes: License fees, bar memberships and continuing legal education

Name: Legal research and practice software
Notes: Research subscriptions, practice management and e-filing services

Name: Merchant fees
Notes: Card processing fees, charged to operating, never to trust

Name: Bank fees
Notes: Operating account fees. Trust account fees are set to draw from operating too
